observations.title: Snow field and ball material across action
observations.observation: Rolling and stacked balls remain flat white rounded panels with generic rims/shadows over a large grey panel ground.
observations.same_scene_comparison: The approved painted carrot, coal, Roshan and source-book snow surfaces carry authored contours, material and light. Coal is intentionally angular/dark; snow should remain soft/cool.
observations.proposed_update: Reuse a suitable clean painted snowball and calm snowy ground if found. Otherwise name only those gaps, drawing one coherent ball family for rolling, three stack sizes and eating states. Retain child construction and separate face placement.
observations.limits: Reference page protected and unchanged; context fixture does not establish natural route, phone touch or full-speed motion acceptance.

observations.title: Snowman stacked support/contact
observations.observation: The top sphere reads as separated from the middle by a narrow gap/dark seam.
observations.same_scene_comparison: Current source centers210/385 with radii72/98 yield a5px separation between head bottom282 and middle top287 before rims/shadows; the lower pair overlap. Painted snowbook volumes join as one supported stack.
observations.proposed_update: Review painted contact footprints and stable stacking anchors together. Repair support readability rather than placing an unrelated new sticker over each generic disc. Keep three independently constructed balls and face anchors coherent.
observations.limits: 5px is source geometry, not a measured pixel gap or child verdict. All scaling, stack transition and chase occlusions require review.

observations.title: Coal eye reuse
observations.classification: Existing painted raster; no automatic vector defect
observations.observation: The live coal is the later painted Pass35 card, not the historical orthographic render.
observations.same_scene_comparison: Dark irregular facets, indigo contour and subtle surface marks fit the painted carrot family while distinguishing hard coal from soft snow. Repeated eyes use the same whole card.
observations.proposed_update: Prefer retaining current approved coal and review its size/contact inside the new snow-head material. Audit card-frame presentation separately; no novelty redraw commissioned.
source_or_native_evidence: ASSET_LICENSES.md historical row161 and superseding row224
observations.limits: 42x42 face rects and110px tap cards have different readability needs. Device/child/owner acceptance remains open.

observations.title: Snowman bite acting/contact
observations.classification: Existing presentation gap; requires animation/contact context
observations.observation: Balls disappear using scale(1.3,0.2) over0.18s. Third/head eating occurs high above Roshan’s fixed chase height, and the last head can remain briefly as a thin white oval during the payoff.
observations.same_scene_comparison: The detailed Roshan card remains at chase center y470 while the head begins at y210. Better snow texture alone does not establish a readable eating/contact action.
observations.proposed_update: Audit the entire bite transition and authored contact/settle cues before accepting a new ball family. Any needed character action uses approved identity states and a bounded2D animation job card, preserving the existing chase/catch objective and source provenance.
observations.limits: Stills and source establish a presentation concern, not a reviewed full-motion verdict. No character pixels or gameplay mechanics changed.

observations.title: Xmas completed topper obscured by reward
observations.classification: Source and native confirmed reward-placement defect
observations.observation: The medal card covers nearly the entire newly placed friendship-flower topper.
observations.same_scene_comparison: The detailed tree and five ornaments are readable before completion. The meaningful new sixth object is covered at the exact payoff.
observations.proposed_update: Preserve tree, ornaments and protected flower. Give the one-owner medal a per-caller placement or sequencing that lets the child see the complete decorated tree/topper; replacing only its material at the same bounds is insufficient.
source_or_native_evidence: Source flower rect570,135/140x130; medal rect490,140/300x230; medal2.2s and picture close1.6s
observations.limits: No source image edit or new tree commissioned. Full lifetime, reentry and phone safe-area checks still required.

observations.title: Trampoline objective/header placement
observations.observation: The large painted objective star sits over the instruction panel through all three bounce apex captures. The detached mat highlight remains below the pad.
observations.same_scene_comparison: Roshan, star and proposed trampoline need a clear shared play space; the header should not compete with the object she reaches.
observations.proposed_update: Use the protected trampoline page as source appearance/context direction for a blue padded frame and dark mesh. Inventory a complete reusable mat, otherwise derive or draw only the clean isolated pad gap. Test header/target spacing and mat contact at every bounce, preserving one-finger input and the existing three-bounce objective.
observations.limits: Book people and overlapping mats cannot be copied blindly into the current playable object. Original remains protected. Full-speed jump/landing review is pending.

observations.title: Xmas flower enabled-state appearance
observations.observation: The enabled flower uses modulate(1.3,1.3,1.0), which makes it paler/brighter than its source card and neighboring ornaments.
observations.same_scene_comparison: The disabled flower starts at0.5 grey; five placed ornaments retain their authored jewel/material appearance.
observations.proposed_update: Preserve the protected flower pixels and audit a separate compatible selection/ready cue around it instead of relying on a source-color wash. Keep locked/enabled distinction and exact unlock behavior.
observations.limits: Presentation proposal only; no permission inferred to restyle the protected flower.

observations.title: Sticker reward icons and reward overlap
observations.classification: Visible progress/decorative glyph art plus ordinary text
observations.observation: Snowman sticker and carrot sticker toasts use emoji artwork. The carrot toast crosses the top of the medal card during payoff.
observations.same_scene_comparison: Painted coal/carrot gameplay objects have stable project identity; emoji appearance depends on the platform/font rather than the authored scene family.
observations.proposed_update: Inventory authored sticker-icon reuse. Treat the decorative/progress icon separately from ordinary label text, and audit the two simultaneous reward surfaces for hierarchy/overlap while preserving every save key and award trigger.
observations.limits: Bind exact glyph and caller roles to the existing glyph inventory before adding counts. Device font/render evidence remains pending.
